products.name: EX Holon Phantoms Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs of 9 cards, no code card (Potomac Distribution box page and TCGplayer's pack text). TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs. Elite Fourum's rarity guide puts a Mew secret rare (111) on top of a box: it is in no pack and is not simulated.
